Chugunov's factory is named for his dead daughter. The Rokot's recon found its energy consumption far beyond the legal limit, so Kresnik Kristall that should have warmed outlying towns went to the plant. Vodyanitsa's group wanted evidence to demand its closure and arranged for the energy specialist Mitya to look into it. After the theater incident Chugunov orders production halted and workers laid off with fair compensation, saying the energy should go to those who need it.

Mitya's report confirmed overtime and excessive energy use. Had it been formally raised, The Rooster would have ordered a halt, an investigation and a penalty, a process of about a week that did not make that Veche session.

1.content:
Chugunov's daughter Iskra died of Frostblight (the snow cough) at six. His wife left soon after. A year later the Jester announced a real cure, and Chugunov realised all earlier treatments, including Frostfairy Flower brews he had made for her, had been useless. He cannot forgive that the cure came one year too late. He lived in a delusion for years.

This is how he recognised the girl called Tonia as one of the "deceased": she said her brother brewed Frostfairy Flower medicine for her, a treatment from the era when the disease was incurable. If Iskra lived, she would be about the same age as Ptashka.

2.content: Chugunov says that Lelek (Odette's secret persona) broke into his home while he slept and left a letter demanding he vote against Project Stuzha, and that he did as asked. He accuses Odette repeatedly in the theater. Late in the ordeal she tells him to close the plant, and he agrees. Vodyanitsa and Mitya note that the theater deaths are not Lelek's style.

3.content: At the Snezhnograd Veche session, Chugunov votes against continuing Project Stuzha. Vodyanitsa is surprised, since a factory owner would normally favor it. Reasoning that restricting the public only squeezes the factories, she had planned to talk him round after official sanctions. Instead, someone had applied force first. Continuation still passes, with 61 percent in favor.

4.content: Tonia, who is later revealed as the long-dead Ptashka, steps between Chugunov and an angry Valeriy early on, even while calling him a puffed-up, pig-headed windbag. He lies that he knows her as Childe's sister to protect her. When she says she must walk into the snowstorm, he tries to stop her, saying he cannot fail again. She tells him she dislikes how he projects Iskra onto her, which delayed her passing and cost others their lives. He apologises. She leaves.

5.content: Mitya works out that everyone in the theater is already dead. Ronova, disguised as Alyosha, reveals herself and kills Chugunov and Odette on the sixth night. Chugunov had worked out that the other bodies in the room were not decaying. Once Ronova is repelled, everyone in the theater returns. After this, Chugunov closes his factory.
